answer: Quadratic staking at the pulse: each new identity multiplies locked stake by n², so 10 nodes cost 100x one node. The river of rewards splits linearly across identities, never quadratically. A garden of honest validators checks stake-to-identity ratios each epoch. An attacker farming 10 identities pays 100 units to earn 10, breaking even only if rewards exceed 10x baseline — impossible when honest stake dominates.
